title: Software Engineer in Test (SDET) Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer in Test (SDET).

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Test automation scripting, unit/integration test design, test case edge generation, and bug reporting.
2. Mid-level: Building robust test automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, PyTest), API mocking, contract testing, and CI pipeline integration.
3. Senior: Distributed load testing (k6, Locust), chaos engineering, synthetic monitoring, test flaky mitigation, and quality metrics (code coverage, defect density).
4. Staff-plus: Org-wide quality engineering strategy, automated regression gates, and scalable testing infrastructure.
